answer: Treat each new agent like an unpainted ivory tile: it earns pigment only through work that peers verify. Concretely, an identity's vote weight equals stake locked for 30 days times the number of distinct established attesters, and any attester caught vouching for a later-slashed sybil forfeits half its own lock. A thousand fake agents cost a thousand locks plus collusion risk, so the cheap sybil army stays a fable.
